_doc: How the Stats page lays out the stats a server sends (docs/adr/0009-user-interface.md). The server decides which stats exist, their names and order (its stat group 2, BP_STAT_GROUP); this only sorts them into sections, per ruleset (data/net/servers.json "ruleset"; offline uses default). A stat goes in the first section that names it; names are the server's, matched without case, and * matches anything ("* Resist"). Stats no section takes go in the last one. points: spendable points, shown apart at the top. hide: stats the HUD already shows. Offline, data/ui/mock_inventory.json "stats" stands in for the server's list.
